title: Kumbha's brother, Nikumbha faces the battle
introduction: Seeing Kumbha his brother killed in battle, the enraged Nikumbha with an iron club as his weapon roars and faces the battle. Hanuma directly attacks Nikumbha, by striking his fist forcibly on Nikumbha's breast. Unmoved by that blow, Nikumbha lifts Hanuma, off the ground. Hanuma in retaliation frees himself and throws down Nikumbha on the ground. Hanuma descends on Nikumbha, pounds his chest with his fist, catches his head and tears it off. Thus, Nikumbha dies at the hands of Hanuma.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये युद्धकांडे सप्तसप्ततितमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 77th chapter in Yuddha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
निकुम्भो भ्रातरं दृष्ट्वा सुग्रीवेण निपातितम् |
प्रदहन्निव कोपेन वानरेन्द्रमुदैक्षत
verses.iast:
nikumbho bhrātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā sugrīveṇa nipātitam |
pradahanniva kopena vānarendramudaikṣata
verses.translation: Seeing his brother stretched on the ground, Nikumbha cast angry looks at Sugreeva, as it would burn him into ashes.

glosses.meaning: as is would burn him (into ashes).

verses.devanagari:
ततः स्रग्दामसंनद्धं दत्तपञ्चाङ्गुलम् शुभम् |
आददे परिघं धीरो महेन्द्रशिखरोपमम्
verses.iast:
tataḥ sragdāmasaṃnaddhaṃ dattapaJṇcāṇ^gulam śubham |
ādade parighaṃ dhīro mahendraśikharopamam
verses.translation: Then, Nikumbha of firm mind grasped his iron club, stupendous like the crest of Mount Mandara and which was bright, festooned with wreaths and provided with iron plates, measuring five digits in breadth.

glosses.meaning: stupendous like the crest of Mount Mandara
and provided with iron plates measuring five digits in breadth.

verses.devanagari:
हेमपट्टपरिक्षिप्तं वज्रविद्रुमभूषितम् |
यमदण्डोपमं भीमं रक्षसां भयनाशनम्
verses.iast:
hemapaṭṭaparikṣiptaṃ vajravidrumabhūṣitam |
yamadaṇḍopamaṃ bhīmaṃ rakṣasāṃ bhayanāśanam
verses.translation: Round it ran a broad strip of gold while diamonds and rubies studded it all over. Like the death-dealing rod of Yama, it seemed causing dismay to the monkeys and nerving the demons with courage.

glosses.meaning: round it ran a broad strip of gold
while diamonds and rubies studded it all over
like the death-dealing rod of Yama (it seemed)
and nerving the demons with courage.

verses.devanagari:
तमाविध्य महातेजाः शक्रध्वजसमौजसम् |
निननाद विवृत्तास्यो निकुम्भो भीमविक्रमः
verses.iast:
tamāvidhya mahātejāḥ śakradhvajasamaujasam |
ninanāda vivṛttāsyo nikumbho bhīmavikramaḥ
verses.translation: Wielding that weapon, which in size resembled the flag-staff of Indra, Nikumbha of terrific prowess, roared with his mouth yawing wide.

glosses.meaning: which in size resembled the flag-staff of Indra

verses.devanagari:
उरोगतेन निष्केण भुजस्थैरङ्गदैरपि |
कुण्डलाभ्यां च चित्राभ्यां मालया च स चित्रया
निकुम्भो भूषणैर्भाति तेन स्म परिघेण च |
यथेन्द्रधनुषा मेघः स विद्युत्स्तनयित्नुमान्
verses.iast:
urogatena niṣkeṇa bhujasthairaṇ^gadairapi |
kuṇḍalābhyāṃ ca citrābhyāṃ mālayā ca sa citrayā
nikumbho bhūṣaṇairbhāti tena sma parigheṇa ca |
yathendradhanuṣā meghaḥ sa vidyutstanayitnumān
verses.translation: On his chest shone a medal of gold. His arms were held by beautiful bracelets. Lustrous pendants depended from his ear. Resplendent garland enfolded his neck. With these ornaments and with his club, Nikumbha assumed the threatening semblance of a cloud, with lightning and thunder and shot with a vivid rainbow.

verses.devanagari:
परिघाग्रेण पुस्फोट वातग्रन्थिर्महात्मनः |
प्रजज्वाल सघोषश्च विधूम इव पावकः
verses.iast:
parighāgreṇa pusphoṭa vātagranthirmahātmanḥ |
prajajvāla saghoṣaśca vidhūma iva pāvakaḥ
verses.translation: The strong Nikumbha, with his arms as strong as his club, hurled his club having sun-like splendour, on the breast of that mighty Hanuma.

glosses.meaning: the noise was like the bursting yell of seven winds of heaven

verses.devanagari:
नगर्या विटपावत्या गन्धर्वभवनोत्तमैः |
सताराग्रहनक्षत्रं सचन्द्रं समहाग्रहम्
निकुम्भपरिघाघूर्णं भ्रमतीव नभःस्थलम् |
verses.iast:
nagaryā viṭapāvatyā gandharvabhavanottamaiḥ |
satārāgrahanakṣatraṃ sacandraṃ samahāgraham
nikumbhaparighāghūrṇaṃ bhramatīva nabhaḥsthalam |
verses.translation: The sky above appeared whirled around in the toss of Nikumbha's club, as though Alaka the City with the palaces of Gandharvas performed rapid revolutions and the moon and the stars and the planets joining the rotating race.

glosses.meaning: in the toss of Nikumbha's club

glosses.itrans: (performing rapid revolutions) sa taaraagrahanakShatram sachandram samahaagraham
glosses.iast: (performing rapid revolutions) sa tārāgrahanakṣatram sacandram samahāgraham
glosses.devanagari: (पेर्fओर्मिन्ग् रपिद् रेवोलुतिओन्स्) स ताराग्रहनक्षत्रं सचन्द्रं समहाग्रहं
glosses.meaning: and moon and the stars and the planets

verses.devanagari:
दुरासदश्च संजज्ञे परिघाभरणप्रभः
क्रोधेन्धनो निकुम्भाग्निर्युगान्ताग्निरिवोत्थितः |
verses.iast:
durāsadaśca sañjajJṇe parighābharaṇaprabhaḥ
krodhendhano nikumbhāgniryugāntāgnirivotthitaḥ |
verses.translation: The hot tempered fire of Nikumbha, which had his club and ornaments for its flame and his fury as its fuel, became dangerous to be approached, like the fire rising at the time of dissolution of the world.

glosses.meaning: the hot tempered fire of nikumbha
which had club and ornaments for its flame
and his fury as its face
like the fire risen at the time of dissolution of the world.

verses.devanagari:
राक्षसा वानराश्चापि न शेकुः स्पन्दितुं भयात्
हनुमांस्तु विवृत्योरस्तस्थौ प्रमुखतो बली |
verses.iast:
rākṣasā vānarāścāpi na śekuḥ spandituṃ bhayāt
hanumāṃstu vivṛtyorastasthau pramukhato balī |
verses.translation: The demons and the monkeys too, out of fear, were unable even to make the slightest movement. The mighty Hanuma, on his part, stood alone among them, with his breast bared to the fury of the attack, in front of Nikumbha.

glosses.meaning: with his breast bared (to the fury of the attack)

verses.devanagari:
परिघोपमबाहुस्तु परिघं भास्करप्रभम्
बली बलवतस्तस्य पातयामास वक्षसि |
verses.iast:
parighopamabāhustu parighaṃ bhāskaraprabham
balī balavatastasya pātayāmāsa vakṣasi |
verses.translation: The strong Nikumbha, with his arms as strong as his club, hurled his club having sun-like splendour, on the breast of that mighty Hanuma.

glosses.meaning: with his arms as strong as his club
with a splendour of the sun

verses.devanagari:
स्थिरे तस्योरसि व्यूढे परिघः शतधा कृतः
विकीर्यमाणः सहसा उल्काशतमिवाम्बरे |
verses.iast:
sthire tasyorasi vyūḍhe parighaḥ śatadhā kṛtaḥ
vikīryamāṇaḥ sahasā ulkāśatamivāmbare |
verses.translation: The titanic club, which fell on the wide and rock-like chest of Hanuma, at once shattered into hundreds of fragments, like hundreds of meteors shattering into the sky.

verses.devanagari:
स तु तेन प्रहारेण विचचाल महाकपिः
परिघेण समाधूतो यथा भूमिचलेऽचलः |
verses.iast:
sa tu tena prahāreṇa vicacāla mahākapiḥ
parigheṇa samādhūto yathā bhūmicale'calaḥ |
verses.translation: That Hanuma, struck by that blow of the club, was unmoved like a mountain in an earthquake.

verses.devanagari:
स तथाभिहतस्तेन हनुमान् पवगोत्तमः
मुष्टिं सम्वर्तयामास बलेनातिमहाबलः |
verses.iast:
sa tathābhihatastena hanumān pavagottamaḥ
muṣṭiṃ samvartayāmāsa balenātimahābalaḥ |
verses.translation: Thus struck by him, the mighty Hanuma the monkey-chief clenched his fist forcibly.

verses.devanagari:
तमुद्यम्य महातेजा निकुम्भोरसि वीर्यवान्
अभिचिक्षेप वेगेन वेगवान् वायुविक्रमः |
verses.iast:
tamudyamya mahātejā nikumbhorasi vīryavān
abhicikṣepa vegena vegavān vāyuvikramaḥ |
verses.translation: The greatly splendoured, powerful and swift Hanuma, with the violence of the wind-god, his father, lifting that fist, struck it against, Nikumbha's breast with force.

verses.devanagari:
तत्र पुस्फोट वर्मास्य प्रसुस्राव च शोणितम् |
मुष्टिना तेन संजज्ञे मेघे विद्युदिवोत्थिता
verses.iast:
tatra pusphoṭa varmāsya prasusrāva ca śoṇitam |
muṣṭinā tena sañjajJṇe meghe vidyudivotthitā
verses.translation: By the blow of that fist there, his armour got split up and red blood profusely oozed out, as a black cloud streaked suddenly with fierce lightning.

verses.devanagari:
स तु तेन प्रहारेण निकुम्भो विचचाल ह |
स्वस्थश्चापि निजग्राह हनूमन्तं महाबलम्
verses.iast:
sa tu tena prahāreṇa nikumbho vicacāla ha |
svasthaścāpi nijagrāha hanūmantaṃ mahābalam
verses.translation: But, by that blow, Nikumbha was unmoved, recovered soon and grasped the unwieldy bulk of Hanuma.

verses.devanagari:
चुक्रुशुश्च तदा संख्ये भीमं लङ्कानिवासिनः |
निकुम्भेनोद्यतं दृष्ट्वा हनूमन्तं महाबलम्
verses.iast:
cukruśuśca tadā saṅkhye bhīmaṃ laṇ^kānivāsinaḥ |
nikumbhenodyataṃ dṛṣṭvā hanūmantaṃ mahābalam
verses.translation: Seeing the mighty Hanuma lifted off the ground in battle, loud roar of exultant joy rose from the ranks of demons.

verses.devanagari:
स तथा ह्रियमाणोऽपि हनुमांस्तेन रक्षसा |
आजघानानिलसुतो वज्रकल्पेन मुष्टिना
verses.iast:
sa tathā hriyamāṇo'pi hanumāṃstena rakṣasā |
ājaghānānilasuto vajrakalpena muṣṭinā
verses.translation: Eventhough he was being carried off in that way by that demon, Hanuma the son of wind-god, struck him with his thunderbolt-like fist.

glosses.meaning: eventhough he was being carried off

verses.devanagari:
आत्मानं मोक्षयित्वाथ क्षितावभ्यवपद्यत |
हनूमानुन्ममाथाशु निकुम्भं मारुतात्मजः
verses.iast:
ātmānaṃ mokṣayitvātha kṣitāvabhyavapadyata |
hanūmānunmamāthāśu nikumbhaṃ mārutātmajaḥ
verses.translation: Freeing himself from Nikumbha, Hanuma the son of wind-god then threw him down on the ground and treated him with blows.

verses.devanagari:
निक्षिप्य परमायत्तो निकुम्भं निष्पिपेष च |
उत्पत्य चास्य वेगेन पपातोरसि वेगवान्
verses.iast:
nikṣipya paramāyatto nikumbhaṃ niṣpipeṣa ca |
utpatya cāsya vegena papātorasi vegavān
verses.translation: Throwing down Nikumbha by main force and with a supreme effort, Hanuma descended on him, leaped on his chest and pounded it mercilessly.

verses.devanagari:
परिगृह्य च बाहुभ्यां परिवृत्य शिरोधराम् |
उत्Pआटयामास शिरो भैरवं नदतो महत्
verses.iast:
parigṛhya ca bāhubhyāṃ parivṛtya śirodharām |
utPāṭayāmāsa śiro bhairavaṃ nadato mahat
verses.translation: Then with both hands, he caught the enemy's neck, twisted it about and tore off his huge head, while Nikumbha was horribly roaring.

verses.devanagari:
अथ निनदति सादिते निकुम्भे |
पवनसुतेन रणे बभूव युद्धम् |
दशरथसुतराक्षसेन्द्रसून्वो |
र्भृशतरमागतरोषयोः सुभीमम्
verses.iast:
atha ninadati sādite nikumbhe |
pavanasutena raṇe babhūva yuddham |
daśarathasutarākṣasendrasūnvo |
rbhṛśataramāgataroṣayoḥ subhīmam
verses.translation: Then, while the roaring Nikumbha was killed in battle by Hanuma, there ensued an exceedingly terrific struggle between the enraged Rama and Makaraksha, son of Khara, a ruler of demons.

verses.devanagari:
व्यपेते तु जीवे निकुम्भस्य हृष्टा |
विनेदुः प्लवंगा दिशः सस्वनुश्च |
चचालेव चोर्वी पपातेव सा द्वौ |
र्बलं राक्षसानां भयम् चाविवेश
verses.iast:
vyapete tu jīve nikumbhasya hṛṣṭā |
vineduḥ plavaṅgā diśaḥ sasvanuśca |
cacāleva corvī papāteva sā dvau |
rbalaṃ rākṣasānāṃ bhayam cāviveśa
verses.translation: When it was clear that Nikumbha had expired, the monkeys shouted with glee, the quarters thundered with satisfaction, the earth rocked with joy, the heaven appeared to crumble and fear seized the army of demons.

glosses.meaning: when it was clear that Nikumbha had expired
